name: Kinoko
source:
Age: 25?
Likes: Mushrooms, pretty girls
Doesn’t like: Strange green birds with fancy hairdos

An alchemist living inside a huge mushroom. Eccentric and happy-go-lucky, she is hardly concerned about giving a good first impression to anyone. She generally attempts to flirt with any girl she encounters, although she is utterly disinterested in anyone older than her.

Despite all the foolish charade, she occasionally makes very sharp remarks and displays her extensive knowledge of alchemy. She is often seen using her magical powers to control alchemical clouds. She calls them the Convenient Clouds.

    “Say, have you seen my skirt lying somewhere around here?”

[From [url=https://arcusplume.com/twin-blue-moons/characters/kinoko/]official website[/url]]
